key_insight: RolloutPipe overlaps rollout generation with training in disaggregated on-policy RLVR by moving complete trainable groups to the trainer as soon as they are ready, reducing idle GPU time without sacrificing on-policy correctness.
engineering_relevance: It improves utilization in heterogeneous multi-GPU LLM post-training systems, making RLVR pipelines faster and more resource-efficient for reasoning-focused models.
method: Complete-group pipelining (CGP): dispatch each finished trainable group FIFO to the trainer immediately after materialization.
Frontier-group dispatch (FGD): prioritize rollout admission for frontier groups needed to assemble the next training batch sooner.
Keeps training on-policy by overlapping stages only after groups are complete, avoiding stale-data training.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B across four reasoning/science benchmarks and twelve rollout settings, achieving 30.7%–42.3% shorter rollout-to-train-end time and 37%–76% lower trainer waiting ratio versus Slime.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on rollout/training balance and correct frontier-group scheduling, so integration complexity and workload sensitivity may affect real deployments.
paper_title: RolloutPipe: Overlapping Pipelined Rollout and Training in Disaggregated On-Policy LLM Reinforcement Learning
